scope: Static ARM64 HTTP/1.1 and HTTPS backend candidate with explicit CA files and synchronous DNS. No implicit Homebrew libraries, system curl, HTTP/2 or HTTP/3. Guest ABI, allocator ownership, external memory contracts and Apple application integration are separate gates. The original Windows DLL is curl 8.15.0 with LibreSSL 4.1.0; this candidate reports its actual newer versions, and is not a claim of exact DLL parity.
